'''Choal''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Battle of Jabiim]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] army under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Norcuna]] was [[Battle of Choal|wiped out]] in fighting near the [[City/Legends|city]].
